[[File:Renshar.png|alt=Three golden hounds on a field of red|thumb|Sign of House Renshar]]'''House Renshar''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Lady [[Arathelle Renshar]] is the [[High Seat]] of House Renshar.

==Sigil==
The sigil of House Renshar is three Golden Hounds.

==Activities==
During the [[Third Succession War]], House Renshar supported [[House Trakand]] gaining the throne.

House Renshar was among the three great Houses that met with the [[Amyrlin Seat]] [[Egwene]] in [[Murandy]]{{ref/book|8|17}}.

During the [[Fourth Succession War]], House Renshar was initially among the six neutral great Houses. After the Siege of Caemlyn House Renshar supported [[Elayne Trakand]] due [[Dyelin Taravin]] speech in her favour{{ref/book|11|35}}.
